fundingAndReverseConventions: Cash fixed-capital spending after disclosed budgets is D&A plus full nominal growth of opening net PP&E, not D&A maintenance alone. XOM additionally retains a source gross cash-investment floor.

Debt/net PP&E and effective D&A/net PP&E are frozen FULL source ratios, not arbitrary half-turnover or invented economic life. Source cash interest follows debt. Published maturities and recurring rollovers are funded explicitly; future access and par issuance/no extra fees are labelled conditions.

Actual operating AR, inventories, other current assets, trade payables and FSLR customer advances are retained. Minimum-cash growth consumes common cash. No cash release or second net-debt subtraction.

Every negative annual FCFE is recorded as a required voluntary pro-rata current-owner contribution with zero post-funding residual, not unmodelled outside capital, guaranteed compulsory calls or constant future share count.

FSLR and NEE signed-path comparison uses a separately certified finite polynomial, not a silent relaxation of shared legacy controls. FSLR has positive derivative lower bounds across 512 intervals; NEE proofs exclude roots in the below-target prefix then certify the crossing region. Independent dated-PV repricing passes.

Reverse output remains a path-preserving FCFE adjustment, NOT an observed/projected operating-growth estimate, g_CAT, causal climate coefficient or probability. The original earnings/ROE namespace is unchanged.

Full cash-reserve, customer advance, PP&E replacement/growth, debt/interest and operating-WC funding are charged. Legacy grant/Visa distributions are explicitly zero in this downside funding model, not omitted or represented as observed writeoffs/collections.
